packageRules.description: Disable major updates for bincode until msvc-kit supports bincode v3. See: https://github.com/vx-org/vx/pull/378

Hold the opentelemetry monorepo below 0.33.0 in step with the tracing-opentelemetry cap below. Bumping the monorepo to 0.33.0 on its own splits the dependency graph and breaks the vx-metrics build. See: https://github.com/vx-org/vx/pull/1127

Hold tracing-opentelemetry below 0.34.0 while the monorepo stays on 0.32.x. tracing-opentelemetry 0.34.0 is built against opentelemetry 0.33.0, so taking it on its own leaves vx-metrics matching an opentelemetry 0.32 SdkTracer against the opentelemetry 0.33 Tracer bound in OpenTelemetryLayer::with_tracer (E0277, then E0599 on with_filter). Lift both caps together when the monorepo is ready to move to 0.33. See: https://github.com/vx-org/vx/pull/1158
